title: Stop Drinking 3 Hours Before Bed
hook: Your last drink should be at least three hours before you go to bed.
body:
I know a lot of you are about to argue with me because alcohol knocks you out faster. But falling asleep quickly is not high quality sleep. Alcohol wrecks your sleep quality, and I can see it on my Oura Ring every single time I drink. Deep sleep collapses. Heart rate stays elevated all night.

Bad sleep means worse recovery, more hunger the next day and less willpower to say no to anything.

This is a sleep protection rule. The further the alcohol is from your bedtime, the more of it your body has already cleared and the less of your deep sleep it takes from you. Same number of drinks, same night out. You just front-load it and stop early.
close: Leave a comment to let me know what time you usually have your last drink.
